description: Take out the Cα atoms and the inhibitor
content: Reads the ATOM / HETATM records of the PDB and takes out the coordinates of the protein's Cα atoms and of the inhibitor (chain C, a parameter). Shows them as a 3D point cloud, Cα in blue and the inhibitor in red, and logs the number of residues and atoms per chain.

outputs.name: atoms
outputs.description: The result of taking out the Cα atoms and the inhibitor
